slides.title: Kelajakni Ifodalashning 2 Xil Usuli
slides.body:
• WILL + V1: Spontan (o'sha zahoti, gapirish paytida qabul qilingan) qarorlar, va'dalar va shaxsiy bashoratlar.
• BE GOING TO + V1: Oldindan o'ylangan reja va niyatlar yoki ko'z o'ngimizdagi aniq dalilga asoslangan taxminlar.
💡 O'zbekcha qopqon: O'zbek tilida har ikki holatda ham '-aman / -adi' deyiladi. Lekin ingliz tilida niyat/reja va spontanlik qat'iy farqlanadi!

slides.title: Tezkor Qarorlar, Va'dalar va Shaxsiy Fikrlar
slides.body:
• Formula: Subject + will + V1 (inkor: won't + V1)
• 1. Spontan qaror: 'The phone is ringing. I will answer it.' (Hozirgina eshitdim va qaror qildim).
• 2. Va'da berish: 'I promise I will not tell anyone.'
• 3. Shaxsiy fikr/bashorat: 'I think people will live on Mars by 2050.' (Fikr/tushuncha, hozircha dalil yo'q).

slides.title: Oldindan Rejalar va Dalilli Bashoratlar
slides.body:
• Formula: Subject + am/is/are + going to + V1
• 1. Oldindan tuzilgan reja: 'We are going to buy a new car next week.' (Pul yig'ilgan, qaror allaqachon qabul qilingan).
• 2. Dalilga asoslangan taxmin: 'Look at those dark clouds! It is going to rain.' (Ko'z oldimizda osmon qorayib turibdi — dalil!).

slides.title: Will vs Be Going To: Tanqidiy Farqlar
slides.body:
• 'I will help you with your bag.' ✅ (O'sha zahoti yordam taklif qilindi).
• 'I am going to help you.' ❌ (Go'yo yordam berishni bir necha kun oldin rejalashtirib yurgandek eshitiladi).
• 'Watch out! You are going to drop the glass!' ✅ (Qo'lidan sirpanib ketyapti — dalil bor).
• 'I think you will pass the exam.' ✅ ('I think' bilan odatda will keladi).

slides.title: O'quvchilar Tushadigan 3 Katta Tuzoq
slides.body:
• ❌ 'I will to call you.' ➔ ✅ 'I will call you.' ('will' dan keyin 'to' ishlatilmaydi!).
• ❌ 'Look, he will fall!' ➔ ✅ 'Look, he is going to fall!' (Dalil bor holatda be going to kerak).
• ❌ 'We bought tickets. We will fly to Rome.' ➔ ✅ '...We are going to fly to Rome.' (Rejalashtirilgan).

slides.title: Qaysi Birini Tanlash Kerak? (Decision Tree)
slides.body:
1. Qaror hozir, gapirish paytida qabul qilindimi? ➔ WILL
2. Qaror oldinroq qabul qilingan rejamidi? ➔ BE GOING TO
3. Ko'z oldingizda jismoniy dalil yoki belgi bormi? ➔ BE GOING TO
4. Va'da beryapsizmi yoki 'I think/believe' deyapsizmi? ➔ WILL

rules.title: 📌 1-Qoida: Tezkor qarorlar va Va'dalar (Will + V1)
examples: The door is open. I will go and close it.
I promise I will pay you back tomorrow.
Don't worry, I will carry your suitcase.
rules.desc: Nutq jarayonida to'satdan qabul qilingan qarorlar, yordam takliflari yoki qat'iy va'dalar uchun har doim 'will' qo'llaniladi.

examples: We are going to move to a new apartment next month.
She is going to study medicine at university.
I'm going to visit my grandparents on Sunday.
rules.title: ⚡ 2-Qoida: Oldindan tuzilgan niyat va rejalar (Be Going To + V1)
rules.desc: Gapirishdan oldin o'ylab qo'yilgan maqsad, reja yoki chipta/kelishuv bilan mustahkamlangan niyatlar uchun 'am/is/are + going to' ishlatiladi.

rules.title: 👁️ 3-Qoida: Ko'rinib turgan dalilga asoslangan bashorat
examples: Look at the black clouds — it is going to rain!
Be careful! The ladder is wobbling, you are going to fall!
He is driving too fast, he is going to crash!
rules.desc: Agar hozirgi vaziyatda voqea sodir bo'lishiga aniq jismoniy dalil yoki belgi ko'rinib turgan bo'lsa, 'be going to' tanlanadi.

examples: I think life will be easier in the future.
I hope she will succeed in her career.
Perhaps it will stop raining soon.
rules.title: 💭 4-Qoida: Shaxsiy fikr va dalilsiz taxminlar (I think / I hope)
rules.desc: Kelajak haqida shaxsiy qarash, taxmin yoki umid bildirilganda (I think, I believe, probably, perhaps) 'will' ishlatiladi.
